questions.title: 对比实际与预算统一汇总
questions.context: 财务要比较各科目的实际支出和预算，找出超支或结余的情况。
questions.requirements:
分别按科目 account_id 汇总预算金额和 expense（支出）类交易金额；只输出预算表里存在的科目，variance = 实际支出 − 预算，没有实际支出按 0 计算。
输出字段名称及顺序：account_id, variance

referenceSolutions.mysqlSql: WITH b AS (SELECT account_id,SUM(budget_amount) AS budget FROM budgets GROUP BY account_id),a AS (SELECT account_id,SUM(amount) AS actual FROM transactions WHERE direction='expense' GROUP BY account_id) SELECT b.account_id,COALESCE(a.actual,0)-b.budget AS variance FROM b LEFT JOIN a ON a.account_id=b.account_id
referenceSolutions.sqliteSql: WITH b AS (SELECT account_id,SUM(budget_amount) AS budget FROM budgets GROUP BY account_id),a AS (SELECT account_id,SUM(amount) AS actual FROM transactions WHERE direction='expense' GROUP BY account_id) SELECT b.account_id,COALESCE(a.actual,0)-b.budget AS variance FROM b LEFT JOIN a ON a.account_id=b.account_id

hints: 预算和交易是两张“一对多”的表，直接连接汇总会重复计算，要先各自汇总。
用 WITH 把预算和实际支出分别汇总成每个科目一行，再连接。
只保留预算存在的科目，所以预算汇总应是左连接的主表；没有支出的科目用 COALESCE 补 0。
questions.explanation:
先分别把预算与支出汇总到“每个科目一行”，再以预算为主做左连接，variance = COALESCE(实际,0) − 预算。先汇总再连接避免了一对多造成的重复。
易错：预算汇总用了 AVG，而不是 SUM，多条预算记录的科目会算错。

commonErrors.sql: WITH b AS (SELECT account_id,AVG(budget_amount) AS budget FROM budgets GROUP BY account_id),a AS (SELECT account_id,SUM(amount) AS actual FROM transactions WHERE direction='expense' GROUP BY account_id) SELECT b.account_id,COALESCE(a.actual,0)-b.budget AS variance FROM b LEFT JOIN a ON a.account_id=b.account_id
commonErrors.reason: 预算应使用 SUM 汇总；AVG 会让多条预算记录的科目结果错误。
